sentences.ar: أهلي كان عندهم نزل صغير عالبحر.
sentences.en: My family had a small inn by the sea.
My name is Jim, and I was a boy then.

sentences.ar: بيوم، إجا رجل كبير وسكن عندنا.
sentences.en: One day, an old man came and stayed with us.

sentences.ar: وجهه فيه ندبة كبيرة وشعره أبيض.
sentences.en: His face had a big scar and his hair was white.

sentences.ar: كان يشرب كتير ويغني أغاني بحارة.
sentences.en: He drank a lot and sang sailors’ songs.
He gave me money and said: watch the road.

sentences.ar: إذا شفت بحري بإجر وحدة، قول لي.
sentences.en: If you see a sailor with one leg, tell me.

sentences.ar: من يومها صرت أحلم فيه بالليل.
sentences.en: From that day I dreamed of him at night.
